en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting an old-style electric tram/carriage passing over a bridge in a European city. The tram is labeled 'GRINDSTUGAN' and there are people in early 20th-century fashion walking and cycling on the street. The background shows several classical multi-story buildings typical of northern European architecture. The lower part of the postcard contains Swedish text and a handwritten date.
